name: API ISARUD
author: ISARUD

sections.description:
API ISARUD is a powerful WooCommerce plugin that simplifies managing your online store by integrating it with popular marketplaces. With support for Trendyol, N11, Hepsiburada, Amazon, Etsy, Shopify, and Pazarama, you can manage inventory, sync prices, track orders, and map products directly from your WordPress dashboard.

Key Features:
* Centralized stock management across marketplaces
* Automatic inventory synchronization
* Bulk product updates with variation support
* Order tracking and status updates
* Secure API connections with OAuth 2.0 and REST/SOAP support
* User-friendly admin panel with detailed statistics and error logs
* Multi-language support (Turkish and English)

External services

This plugin connects to several marketplace APIs to synchronize product data:

Trendyol

  • Service: Trendyol Seller Center API
  • Purpose: Product and inventory management
  • Data sent: Product details, stock levels, prices
  • API Documentation: https://developers.trendyol.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://www.trendyol.com/sozlesmeler/satici-uye-sozlesmesi

N11

  • Service: N11 Merchant API
  • Purpose: Product and inventory management
  • Data sent: Product details, stock levels, prices
  • API Documentation: https://api.n11.com/ws/
  • Terms of Service: https://www.n11.com/genel/satici-uyelik-sozlesmesi-76

HepsiBurada

  • Service: HepsiBurada Marketplace API
  • Purpose: Product and inventory management
  • Data sent: Product details, stock levels, prices
  • API Documentation: https://developers.hepsiburada.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://www.hepsiburada.com/satici-sozlesmeleri

Amazon

  • Service: Amazon MWS API
  • Purpose: Product and inventory management
  • Data sent: Product details, stock levels, prices
  • API Documentation: https://developer-docs.amazon.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/external/G1791

Pazarama

  • Service: Pazarama Seller API
  • Purpose: Product and inventory management
  • Data sent: Product details, stock levels, prices
  • API Documentation: https://developer.pazarama.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://www.pazarama.com/satici-sozlesmesi

Etsy

  • Service: Etsy Open API
  • Purpose: Product and inventory management
  • Data sent: Product details, stock levels, prices
  • API Documentation: https://developers.etsy.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://www.etsy.com/legal/sellers/

Shopify

  • Service: Shopify Admin API
  • Purpose: Product and inventory management
  • Data sent: Product details, stock levels, prices
  • API Documentation: https://shopify.dev/api/admin
  • Terms of Service: https://www.shopify.com/legal/terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the “API ISARUD” menu in the WordPress admin panel to configure marketplace settings.
  4. Map your WooCommerce products with the desired marketplaces.
  5. Start stock synchronization.
